newsitem.title: USA: Radiant Systems sets public offering.
newsitem.headline: Radiant Systems sets public offering.

text.p: Radiant Systems Inc said Wednesday it plans a public offering of 3.4 million shares of common stock at $23.75 per share.
Of the shares offered, 2,602,888 shares are offered by the company and 797,112 shares are being offered by certain selling shareholders.
The company has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 510,000 shares to cover overallotments.
Radiant Systems will have approximately 15.2 million shares of common stock outstanding following the offering.
The company said proceeds will be used to repay indebtedness, and for general corporate purposes, including possible strategic acquisitions and working capital.
